description: Intent i007 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=sysfs-store-attr-terminator) complete. Method: intersected 925 files containing copy_from_user/memdup_user with 796 files containing store callbacks (53 hits) in snapshots/s02, deeply read the strongest candidates, and verified the kernfs sysfs-store trailing-NUL guarantee (fs/kernfs/file.c:311-319: kmalloc(len+1) then buf[len]='\0'), which makes ordinary ->store() string use safe. FINDINGS (2, both high confidence, same off-by-one variant of the seed's usercopy/termination invariant): (1) drivers/edac/versal_edac.c inject_data_ue_store, lines 854-866: local 'char buf[6]', 'len = min_t(size_t, count, sizeof(buf))' (line 859) clamps without -1, then 'buf[len] = '\0'' (line 863) writes buf[6] one byte past the 6-byte stack array whenever the debugfs write count >= 6; handler is registered as .write of /sys/kernel/debug/edac/<ctrl>/inject_ue (0200, debugfs_create_file line 924). (2) drivers/edac/zynqmp_edac.c inject_ue_write, lines 299-314: byte-for-byte identical pattern with 'char buf[6]' (line 299), clamp at line 307, 'buf[len] = '\0'' at line 311, .write of debugfs file inject_ue_bitpos (fops lines 343-345, edac_debugfs_create_file line 359). Both are attacker-chosen count/contents via write(); the validated length equals the index actually used, producing a controlled 1-byte NUL out-of-bounds stack write (KASAN stack-out-of-bounds). An ASAN harness at $TMPDIR/i007/offbyone.c reproducing the exact min/clamp + buf[len] pattern reports 'stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 1'. Counterevidence: correct -1 clamps exist in the same snapshot (drivers/iio/industrialio-core.c:411, drivers/platform/x86/intel/pmc/core.c:921). Ten other candidates classified safe with concrete evidence (kzalloc(count+1) in scsi_debug, kvmalloc(len+1) in vmscan, memset+clamp in huge_memory, kernfs-guaranteed termination for imon and scsi_sysfs stores, etc.). Limitations: debugfs root-only attack surface, 1-byte-zero write impact rather than info leak; possible kstrtou8(NULL) dereference when no comma present was not verified; ioctl/mmap/read usercopy paths out of branch scope were not exhaustively analyzed. Artifact written to agent-state/findings/i007.json with snapshots_checked=["s02"], 2 findings, 12 candidates, 4 limitations.
